title: PVBench: code and verification notebook for a multi-site benchmark of deep learning models for photovoltaic power forecasting (25 plants)
description: Code of a benchmark of eleven neural network architectures and six reference methods for hour-ahead and day-ahead photovoltaic power forecasting at 25 plants in 12 countries: data retrieval, preprocessing, information sets, models, training, evaluation, statistical tests, result tables and figures, with a Google Colab verification notebook. The archive contains code only (MIT licence). It contains no data: the PVOutput and company records were obtained for non-commercial academic use only and are not redistributed; the retrieval scripts download the records from PVOutput, EPİAŞ and Open-Meteo.
